relationships.subject: ibuprofen
relationships.evidence_quote: The combination of these drugs produced a supra-additive response with an interaction index of 0.13.

relationships.subject: AM630
relationships.evidence_quote: On the other hand, the synergism of COMB was significantly reduced at 76% (p < 0.0001) in the presence of AM630.

relationships.subject: AM281
relationships.evidence_quote: The synergistic effect of COMB (63.56 ± 2.14%) was significantly reduced at 45% (p < 0.0001) in the presence of AM281 in the formalin test (Figure 4), suggesting the participation of the CB1 receptor in the antinociceptive synergism.

relationships.subject: WIN 55,212-2
relationships.evidence_quote: It is known that the activation of the CB1 and CB2 cannabinoid receptors by WIN inhibits the activity of TRPV1 receptors [33,34]

key_findings: Peripheral WIN 55,212-2 plus systemic ibuprofen produced supra-additive antinociception in the rat formalin test (interaction index 0.13).
CB2 receptor antagonism reduced the synergism by 76% versus 45% for CB1 antagonism.
